data.text: Every FastAPI route and agent tool using the shared SQLite connection must be async def, never plain def. Plain def runs on a worker thread. New test apps/agent/tests/test_shared_connection.py enforces this for app routes and toolsets. Check facility_api.py and other new routes when merging with PR 4.
data.rationale: With parallel reads, /api/requests returned 500s, 404s, empty lists and wrong statuses (a resolved order shown as open). After the change, 900 parallel reads were all correct, including during a live agent run.
